digest.component_or_area: plan review gate workflow — LLM pass orchestration and verdict generation
propositions: When a ticket's own material is edited mid-review, all remaining LLM passes run to completion and only fail at sign time with PlanReviewGenerationChanged, wasting computation and checkpoint I/O on invalidated fingerprint-keyed work.
The cancel mechanism must probe only own_material (not relation_snapshot or ticket_store_revision) to avoid reintroducing d70a false cancels on unrelated ticket writes.

Cancel probes at the two pass seams (after finders/before verify-inputs, after decide/before coach-inputs) detect own-material drift via fresh single-ticket reads under local_read_context, avoiding sync-lock contention and store-wide reduction.

When own_material drift is detected, the review returns an unsigned INDETERMINATE verdict with finding id plan-review-cancelled-stale before any coach/verify recovery paths run, and skips all attestation signing and sidecar emission.
In-flight Pass-1 chunks immediately return empty results on cancel without invoking runner or checkpoint I/O, and the pooled worker context carries the cancel token via copy_context.
With no mid-run material change, review behavior and verdict outputs remain byte-identical to the pre-change baseline, and unrelated ticket writes do not trigger false cancellations.
